The hard measurement "DS-ROW-1 ... badges: name gap 8 x2, pill gap 4 (hard)" and the DS-ROW-1 rule ("8 px from the name to the first badge, 4 px between pills") make 4 px the specified gap, so the artboard is wrong here, not the capture.

Only the message leaf above them gives the reason.

The cited Read-only meta and label badges belong to the main panel's comfortable Installed rows (the artboard crop), which is a different surface.
